newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks seen testing 9,600-point resistance.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks seen testing 9,600-point resistance.

text.p: Taiwan share prices were expected to continue the recent bull runs to test the 9,600-point resistance on Monday as construction shares would likely keep on rising, brokers said.
The benchmark stock index rose 1.13 percent higher to close at a new seven-year high of 9,501.08 points on Saturday due to strong performance of construction and electronic shares.
A 9,500-9,620 range was seen for Monday.
"The construction share should continue its upswing, and investors are expected to keep their shares instead of selling them," May Lan of National Securities said.
But brokers also warned of possible retreat after the index tested the 9,600 resistance level.
Saturday's close was the highest since the index hit 9,665.50 points on April 28, 1990.
